films.title: Until You | Sales Sizzle / EPK Film
films.description: Behind the scenes of "Until You," a romantic comedy from writer/director Cameron Ali Fay, starring Megan Fahey and Jack Quaid as two people falling in love in Dublin while each hides a secret that could change everything.

films.title: Comulate: Brand Story
films.description:
"Our first user was crying tears of joy. It was pretty unlike anything we had seen previously." 

Employees at Coate reflect on the impact of their work, the trust they've built with customers, and what it feels like to be early on a massive, largely unsolved problem.

films.title: Comulate: CAC Customer Feature [60]
films.description: Follows an insurance operations team on the brink of burnout and how adopting Coate turned statement processing that once took 45 minutes into a five-minute task, changing their work and their lives.

films.title: Comulate: CAC Customer Feature
films.description:
"The first time we imported a statement, something that took me 45 minutes happened in five. I just kept saying, wow. I was reduced to tears." 

A team on the brink of burnout, working 22-hour days to keep up with statement processing, found their work — and their lives — transformed after adopting Coate.

films.title: Abridge: Partnership is a Privilege
films.description: Health system leaders and Abridge's team describe the collaborative, high-touch process behind every deployment, and the deep partnerships built along the way to bring the technology into clinicians' hands.

films.title: Abridge: Yale New Haven | Customer Feature
films.description:
"Medicine in its current form is not sustainable." 

Follows the rapid adoption of Abridge across a hospital system, from physician skepticism to nearly a thousand clinicians using it daily to turn conversations into structured, actionable data.

films.title: Abridge: Vail Basecamp
films.description:
"Inspiration is the spark that takes strategy and execution and turns that into great achievement." 

A look inside Abridge's Basecamp offsite, where nearly a hundred team members step outside their usual environment to reconnect, reflect, and set the tone for what's next.

films.title: Abridge: Altamed
films.description:
"I even threw some questions in English just to test it, and the platform was able to switch seamlessly." 

A look at how Abridge's real-time translation is transforming care for Spanish-speaking patients at Ultimate, letting physicians stay fully present in the conversation instead of relying on back-and-forth interpretation.

films.title: Abridge: Akron Children's Hospital
films.description:
"Abridge has given me my family life back." 

Physicians in a pediatric emergency department describe how Abridge has eased documentation burden, improved patient satisfaction scores, and restored time with their own families.

films.title: Abridge: Mission Film
films.description:
"They don't just see us as someone to build notes for them. They look at us as a collaborator." 

A look at how Abridge has grown from a small mission-driven team to a trusted partner across more than a hundred health systems, and what that trust means for the future of AI in medicine.

films.title: ABRIDGE: CRE Film Series
films.description: Explores Abridge's contextual reasoning engine, which pulls together clinical, insurance, and institutional data to produce documentation built for both patient care and the complex revenue cycle workflows behind it, and leadership's vision for what comes next.

films.title: Abridge: Love Stories
films.description:
"You've helped save my marriage. You've helped save my relationship with my kids." 

A look inside Abridge's "Love Stories" channel, where clinician feedback about reclaimed family time and renewed purpose keeps the team grounded in why the work matters.

films.title: Abridge: The-Conversation [90]
films.description: The official trailer for The Conversation—Abridge’s flagship event—captures the ideas, voices, and electric atmosphere that define a gathering built to challenge thinking and spark what’s next.

films.title: Abridge: Vision Film [90]
films.description: Abridge marked the arrival of their new product leader with a film that celebrates the next chapter in their journey—blending vision, mission, and momentum into one powerful brand statement.

films.title: Abridge: Vision Film
films.description: Abridge marked the arrival of their new product leader with a film that celebrates the next chapter in their journey—blending vision, mission, and momentum into one powerful brand statement.

films.title: Abridge: Sagar
films.description:
"We get to build life-changing technology, and we get to build strong connections with partners that really is changing the way clinicians practice." 

Employees and leaders across Abridge reflect on what makes the company culture stand out — humility, mentorship, and a shared sense of purpose in transforming healthcare.

films.title: Service Now: Putting AI to Work for People [Sydney/Bangalore]
films.description:
"Lenovo's ambition exactly matches ServiceNow's." 

Filmed across Australia and India, this case study spotlights how ServiceNow integrates its global platform with tech leader Lenovo—demonstrating the scale, precision, and partnership required to power transformation worldwide.

films.title: Parsons The New School: Being the Machine (Full)
films.description:
"Are you asking me the question from an AI or a human point of view?" 

Participants engage in a blind conversation experiment, unsure whether they're talking to a person or an AI, and reflect on where the responses felt real — and where they didn't.

films.title: Parsons The New School: Being the Machine Short Form
films.description:
"What I look for in a human conversation is some sense of connection." 

An AI-vs-human conversation experiment, following participants as they try to spot the difference between talking to a person and talking to AI.

films.title: WSJ: Microsoft Cloud Banking Technology
films.description: Explores how banks and credit unions are turning to cloud technology to innovate faster, cut costs, and meet the needs of an increasingly mobile-first customer base.

films.title: BBC Storyworks: Range Rover
films.description:
"Art dealing is an opportunity to go places." 

Ryan Green, owner and president of Masters Gallery, reflects on the unexpected journeys that come with working in the art world — from appraising collections and connecting with artists to discovering new places through the stories behind each work.

films.title: BBC Storyworks: Range Rover - The Art of the Journey [60]
films.description:
"Art dealing is an opportunity to go places, and if you say yes to the journey, it will take you places you never expected to go." 

An art dealer reflects on how the pursuit of art has become a journey of self-discovery, guiding both personal identity and travel to unexpected places.

films.title: Iberdrola Trailer
films.description:
"We are today writing the future. We are participating in the revolution that is happening in the energy sector." 

A shorter look at Iberdrola's energy storage innovations, exploring how renewables and battery technology are reshaping the future of electricity.

films.title: BBC Storyworks: AWS / Druva
films.description:
"Software should train itself on us, and that's where natural language really flips the script." 

Follows Druva's use of Amazon Bedrock's generative AI to translate between security and IT teams, turning natural language into a critical tool for detecting and responding to attacks.

films.title: BBC Storyworks: NYC EDC - Bringing Business Back
films.description: Featuring Hyeon Yeo, co-chair of the KAIST New York Campus Committee and professor at KAIST's Graduate School of Technology and Innovation Management, this piece looks at what it means to bring real industry perspective into academic innovation in NYC.

films.title: BBC Storyworks: AWS / Feathersnap
films.description:
"AI species identification was something we did not want to launch without." 

Explores how Feather Snap, a smart bird feeder, built its AI-powered species identification on Amazon Bedrock, giving customers a trusted window into their own backyard.

films.title: BBC Storyworks: AWS / Feathersnap [60]
films.description:
"You are really able to open up the window to the wild in your backyard." 

Follows the creators of Feather Snap, a smart bird feeder using AWS's generative AI tools to identify visiting birds by size, beak shape, and wing length — not just color.

films.title: Rockefeller University: COVID Response Film - [Dir. Cut]
films.description:
When a global pandemic swept the planet in 2020 scientists at Rockefeller University rallied their combined resources and expertise to embody their core value of "Science for the Benefit of Humanity".

https://www.rockefeller.edu/

films.title: Behind The Scenes | Sideways The Musical at Buena Vista
films.description:
"When something becomes to intense to say, you break into song."

Sideways brings California wine country to the stage, set against the vineyards and culture of Santa Ynez Valley. .

films.title: Building the Shaker Museum
films.description: Founded in Old Chatham, the Shaker Museum tells the story of the Shakers through a remarkable collection of furniture, clothing, and chairs, alongside a history of entrepreneurship and early advocacy for women's rights. At the height of their influence, Shaker sisters even took clothing orders from the lobby of a Fifth Avenue hotel — a testament to how far their craftsmanship and reputation reached.

films.title: Cardboard Stage: Talentless
films.description:
New York dance choreography duo Cardboard Stage designed an original routine for the latest Talentless fashion line. Little Crush Films produced this short showcase film celebrating the partnership.

No dialogue.

films.title: Accenture: Reinventing the Fortune 500 (Trailer)
films.description: Explores how Fortune is using AI to transform 70 years of Fortune 500 business data into a new kind of journalism — turning decades of history into something interactive, insightful, and entirely first of its kind.

films.title: MINIAC: TRAILER REVISION
films.description:
"It's not just about the car itself. It's like the heart that goes with it." 

A documentary-style look at MINI's fiercely loyal owner community, where a shared sense of humor and quirkiness turns car ownership into genuine camaraderie.

films.title: Cardboard Stage: Live The Process
films.description: An impactful short film for dance choreographers Cardboard Stage, capturing their aura and passion. A 60-second brand sizzle/ident built for their website and owned channels.

films.description:
The Break, a clothing line, partnered with dance choreographers Cardboard Stage for their annual event in Brooklyn. We captured the energy of the event through dynamic coverage of the catwalks, featured performances, and atmosphere, shaping the footage into a fast-paced 60-second recap.

60-second, no dialogue event coverage.

films.title: The March on Washington Film Festival
films.description:
"Art is the best way to deal with tough issues like race relations and the social issues that we're dealing with in our time." 

A look at how the March on Washington Civil Rights Festival uses film, scholarship, and first-person storytelling to bring overlooked history to a new generation.

films.title: Coffee As a Service: Expresso Delight
films.description:
"If you trust it, I believe that art will take care of you. It will guide you to where you want to go." 

A meditative look at art dealing as more than a business — a journey that shapes identity and takes those who follow it to places, both physical and personal, they never expected.

films.title: Watson: Thomas J Watson Fellowship Film
films.description:
"To me, risk is about the most important word in the life of everybody, but it's gotta be a yearning inside of you." 

The Watson Fellowship. A one-year grant sending recent graduates around the world to pursue their deepest interests alone, and the confidence and self-discovery that comes from taking that risk.

films.title: Watson: JKFellowship
films.description:
"I really love the way that they build us holistically." 

Follows the Janet K. Watson Fellowship, a program that sends students around the world for three summer internships in fields like public policy, journalism, and international development — building confidence, community, and a sense of what's possible.

films.title: MSL Legal: Law Firm Commercial | "New York on Pause".
films.description: 30 TVC created to amplify messaging around returning to work sites safely around COVID19. 2x spots were created to run on Local NYC Networks.

films.title: Saffron Road: Brand Film Anthem
films.description:
"Ethical food, free of artificial ingredients, antibiotics, or GMOs, transcends language, religion, and culture." 

Explores Saffron Road's decade-long mission to connect people through premium world cuisine, built on ethical sourcing and a genuine sense of discovery.

films.title: SaffronRoad: New Adventures
films.description:
"Where will your journey take you?" 

Saffron Road turns everyday meals into opportunities for discovery, bringing international flavors and thoughtfully sourced foods to curious explorers looking for their next adventure.

films.film: Saffron Road: More Than Fine Print
films.title: Saffron Road: More Than Fine Print
films.description: A Saffron Road brand film showcasing the company's commitment to high-quality ingredients, authentic world flavors, ethical sourcing, sustainable farming, and better food choices.

films.title: Saffron Road: Our Promise
films.description: Introduces Saffron Road, a brand built on honesty, quality, and authentic world cuisine — sourcing clean ingredients from across the globe to bring premium, time-honored recipes to every table.

films.title: ZAHF 2024: Sister Nelly Correa
films.description:
Sister Nelly Leon Correa – known as “Mother Nelly” – is president and co-founder of Fundación Mujer Levántate (Woman Standing Up Foundation), a non- governmental organization in Chile that supports women in prison and helps restore their dignity and human rights. 

After working with women in the Joaquín Penitentiary Center in Santiago for 19 years, Sister Nelly has become a 2024 honoree for the Zayed Award for human Fraternity.

films.title: The Infamous Future [OFFICIAL TRAILER]
films.description:
"Education is an ocean liner. We have to slowly turn that ocean liner around, and this is a starting point." 

Traces the founding and mission of the Eagle Academy, built to change the trajectory for young Black men facing steep odds in some of New York City's most underserved communities.

Every car has a story behind it. 

For What It’s Worth gives a front seat view of demolition derby drivers Bob “The Killer Bee” Bennison, Kyle Harrigan and Kyle Cohen, as they prepare for New Jersey’s annual Turkey Derby. 

From rural Pennsylvania to the sprawling scrap yards of Suffolk County, this short documentary shows what’s possible even after those cars reach the end of the road.

films.description:
"I think if you ask any Abridge user what is the most effective thing Christus has done in the last 10 years for physician well-being, they will all say Abridge. It won't even be close." 

A look at how Christus Health, an almost 160-year-old health system, has used Abridge to ease documentation burden, improve coding accuracy, and restore physician well-being across thousands of clinicians.

films.description: Abridge's team gathers in Pittsburgh, the company's founding city, to reconnect, celebrate their shared values, and set the tone heading into 2026.

films.title: LC1252_Abridge_LoveNotes_20251215_FINAL_H264
films.description:
"We truly do see it as a privilege to work with each and every single one of the people that we interact with." 

Abridge celebrates its partners through personal letters of appreciation, reflecting on the relationships, milestones, and shared impact built with healthcare teams at Reid Health, the University of Vermont, and UNC Health.

films.title: LC1286_Abridge_SF-Builders-260316-FINAL-H264-HD
films.description: Abridge employees and engineers describe the company's hypergrowth, technical talent, and mission-driven culture — and why they believe it's one of the most important places to build a career in technology right now.

films.title: LC1286_Abridge_CLRF_260413_BF_260413_H264_FINAL
films.description:
"We're adding a new healthcare system every two and a half days. That doesn't happen just because of a product — it happens because we've got the right team out there connecting with our partners." 

Abridge leaders make the case for joining a company built as AI-first from day one, growing faster than most in healthcare tech, and built on trust earned in drops.

films.title: LC1279_Abridge-Rochester-DITL_260414_H264_FINAL
films.description:
"I actually get to see my daughter more because of the Abridge platform." 

A personal look at how one physician's near-burnout, marked by missed vacations and sporting events, turned around after Abridge took clinical documentation off his plate.

films.title: LC1279_Abridge-Rochester-CEO_260415_H264_FINAL
films.description:
"It makes medicine fun again. I can go out there, talk to the patients, do the skills, and I don't have to worry about what's dragging behind me for hours." 

Rochester Regional Health leadership and providers discuss why they invested in Abridge, and how it's restored work-life balance and the joy of medicine for their clinical staff.

films.description: A live demo led by Abridge's CEO, showing how the platform works inside Epic's emergency department workflow, turning a chest pain evaluation into a compliant note complete with differential diagnosis and next steps.

films.title: Abridge: Epic Demo – Ambulatory
films.description:
"You can really focus on the person who's most important, the patient — hit the start button, then hit stop, swivel your chair, and your note, but all the rest of your work, should be there." 

A deep dive into Abridge's ambulatory workflow inside Epic, from real-time note generation and linked evidence to pre-populated orders and diagnosis mapping.

films.title: Abridge: Epic Demo – Abridge For Nurses
films.description: A live demo of Abridge for Nurses, walking through a real patient encounter to show how the tool captures conversation and drafts flow sheet documentation automatically, easing the burden nurses face today.

films.description: Abridge partnered with Inova Health to showcase how their platform integrates seamlessly into clinical workflows—told through the voices of the clinicians and CMIOs using it every day.

Wells Fargo shares perspective on the capital driving the AI ecosystem, from a $7 trillion investment need over the next four years to the power infrastructure required to support it.

"Excellence is a language — passed down, learned, evolving." 

A poetic brand piece for Metrica, framing excellence not as a skill but as a language spoken by few, found in the details, and preserved in the moments it creates.
